notes.title: Space Gears Q3 Development Roadmap
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=3RzkJtZRT84;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]COMMAND MECHS, CONQUER MARS![/b]

Greetings from the Space Gears team.

Thank you for all of your amazing feedback shared with us during Steam Next Fest.
Your input has proven incredibly valuable and has led to several new developments for Space Gears!
Here are some exciting new features planned for the third quarter of 2023.

[b][New Mechs][/b]
- Addition of new Large Mechs: Behemoth and Redmech
- Addition of new Small Mech: Scout
※ Each with Type A and Type B
- Addition of Mech customization skin system

[b][Combat][/b]
- Testing and validating team-based PvP combat
- Team-based PvE mode
- Combat system improvements: 
　→ Queueing movement, hold, and adding various status effects
- Addition of custom matches
- Addition & Quality upgrades of map terrain variations/features

[b][Others][/b]
- Development of HQ Assistant features.
- Addition of NPC shops and manufacturer shops.
- Improvment of in-game art quality.
- Performance optimization.

In addition to the information provided in this announcement, there will be other updates coming up during the third quarter. We will share a separate roadmap to give you a comprehensive overview of all the details.

We also have news on some more features planned for development during the fourth quarter of 2023.

[b][Plans for Q4 2023][/b]
- Addition of 4 new Mechs.
- Mars event system 
　→ Random events on the world map.
- New Commander skill
- Commander skill selection

The Space Gears team welcomes your feedback at any time during the development process.
Give us a shout out on our official Discord community or Twitter if you have any further comments or suggestions. We consider your input to be of the utmost importance as we continue to develop the game.

[b][url=https://discord.gg/spacegears][Space Gears Discord Link][/url]
[url=https://twitter.com/SpaceGears_game][Space Gears Twitter Link][/url][/b]

We appreciate your continued interest in our updates! Stay tuned for more exciting news in the coming weeks. We can't wait to share more details and surprises with you as we continue development of Space Gears. 

Thanks again for your support! We'll be back with more interesting news soon!

notes.title: Playtest starting soon!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=U5yyuGkcjbc;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]COMMAND MECHS, CONQUER MARS![/b]
Greetings from the [b]Space Gears[/b] team,

We're incredibly excited to debut Space Gears across the globe through our very first playtest!

Space Gears is the result of a year-long endeavor by a dedicated team of Korean game developers who share a genuine passion for sci-fi and strategy games. The game is being developed with an emphasis on strategy and fluid combat controls and is slated for early access later this year.

Currently, Space Gears' launch build has reached the midpoint of its development roadmap. The game's most important feature, its 1v1 PvP battle mode, has finally finished and awaits feedback from everyone out there. As such, the goal of this playtest is to check how the game's core combat feature is received by gamers out there and gather suggestions and feedback concerning areas of improvement. The playtest will be followed by additional PvE content, new PvP modes, new map releases, new mech designs and more.

Key features included in this Space Gears playtest build include fast-paced combat, balanced levels of multi-tasking, and exciting PvP battles. To this end, we've prepared intense and highly charged combat, intricately designed maps with multiple interactive elements, and immersive action-packed battles.

We value the input of all strategy and RTS fans across the world and look forward to applying your feedback to improve the game. Please do not hesitate to provide any and all feedback concerning areas of improvement, difficulties playing the game, and other suggestions about the game.

The Space Gears team is committed to making continuous improvements to create the best version of Space Gears possible. We sincerely appreciate your support and eagerly anticipate your participation.

Thank you.

[b][Additional Information][/b]
- To ensure stable matchmaking and gameplay, the PvP mode will only support 1v1 battles.
- Three regions are available: Asia, Americas, and Europe. You are free to switch regions for better matchmaking.
- The playtest build includes a total of 10 mechs. A greater variety of mechs will be made available in the Early Access build.
- We will continue to develop the game's matchmaking systems that take into account diverse environments and factors, while also implementing a range of adjustments to ensure more balanced matchups.
- We highly appreciate your feedback not limited to PvP battles but also all other aspects of the game.

notes.title: Space Gears Development Roadmap
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43770919/01ee871b25206d20b8ba32ef9f9fb0e84c1af7a5.jpg[/img]

[b]COMMAND MECHS, CONQUER MARS![/b]
Greetings from the Space Gears team!

We've taken the liberty of sending a forward team to prepare the Martian environment for your arrival.
Rest assured! We'll also continue working on making sure your terraforming efforts go smoothly as possible once you arrive on Mars.

In that light, we wanted to share the roadmap with you outlining some of the work we're doing.
[b](Note: details in the roadmap may change as development progresses)[/b]

[b][Q1-Q2, 2023][/b]
- Construct production facilities on bases
- PvP / PvE level design
- Basecamp content development
- Raid mode
- Communication between users
- New mech types
- Apply mech skins

[b][Q3, 2023][/b]
- Tutorial overhaul
- Adjutant feature
- New mech types
- Balance rework
- Battle passes

[b][Q4, 2023][/b]
- Guilds
- Guild-based PvP modes
- Martian land ownership features
- Shipments, transport, logistics (non-combat features)
- New mech types

[b][Q1, 2024][/b]
- 100 vs. 100 mode
- Giant robot assembly
- Space station system (factions & policies)
- Satellite system (combat & non-combat perks)
- New mech types

The team will be back with more updates concerning our progress on Mars.

Thank you.
